29c4972609.q: Why did Jimmy Jenkins leave his criminal law career in New York City to return to Florida?
29c4972609.a: His father was diagnosed with late-stage prostate cancer in the late 1990s, and Jenkins felt obligated to help his mother who was serving as the sole caregiver. As an only child, he returned to Florida to assist. When 9/11 happened while his family was adjusting to life back in Florida, Jenkins and his wife decided not to return to New York City, fearing the danger it posed to their children.
29c4972609.e: 1205. Pause in His Law Career Sent Him in the Right Direction
29c4972609.rq: There was a lot of life that I had missed chasing the brass ring by going to law school and pushing on to New York City, and I realized I had missed a lot of time with my parents and extended family, even with my own wife and children.

48d978cafa.q: What role did Samuel Hunter play in shaping Jimmy Jenkins' intellectual development?
48d978cafa.a: Samuel Hunter was a family friend and educator who owned a fruit grove in Vero Beach and was very scientifically minded in his growing philosophies. He taught Jenkins about lunar projections and their impact on irrigation and grove management, which piqued Jenkins' curiosity about scientific thinking and forecasting using data and information at hand.

09cb5c20fc.q: Why did Jimmy Jenkins decide not to obtain a Florida law license after moving back to the state?
09cb5c20fc.a: Jenkins deliberately avoided obtaining a Florida law license because he recognized that if he got licensed, he would chase the brass ring like putting a bone in front of a dog—meaning he would fall back into the hot shot trial lawyer lifestyle he was trying to escape. Instead, he pursued a position as a lawyer editor at a small publishing company in Leon County.
